svg.title: Developer World: The Isles of Code contribution calendar
svg.desc: Real GitHub contribution calendar. 53 weeks by 7 weekdays ending 2026-11-17; 98 active dates; 1552 GitHub-visible contributions. 2 days not covered by GraphQL, shown as unknown. Public event decorations are a recent partial sample. 1 repositories omitted.
